- Butler County, MO
Welcome to the NEW Butler County Web GIS Maps
We offer a premium subscription to the website. The Premium Access
offers detailed parcel information along with the PRC, Sketch, Book and Pages,
FEMA Flood Maps, Ag Soil Grade Classification, Roads, Owners Name, Brief Legal
Descriptions, School District, Voting District, Enhanced Enterprise Zone and
more.
Premium Access – This access includes PRC with building data and values. Unlimited Access to website data.
Only the Yearly Access Package can add additional users (Fees Apply).
Each User is required to have their own user name and password.
(See link below for additional Info)
---ANY SHARING OF USER NAME AND PASSWORD WILL RESULT IN
LOSS OF ACCESS WITHOUT REFUND----
Subscriptions are available by clicking the link below.
https://www.missouricountygov.com/butler_assess/forte/
Any questions please email gis@butlercountymo.com or call the office at (573) 686-8084.
Thank you,
Chris Rickman
Butler County Assessor
